name: Proposal for a decision
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on the numerical strength of the standing committees
part_text:
The European Parliament has fixed how many members each of its standing committees and subcommittees will have. The numbers range from 25 members for the smallest committees to 90 for the largest. The committee and subcommittee leadership teams can have up to four vice-chairs. The decision took effect on the day it was adopted.

- Each committee and subcommittee now has a set number of members, from 25 to 90.
- This affects all members of the European Parliament and how its committees are staffed.
- The decision is already in force; the Parliament President will send it to the Council and Commission for information.
